description: This file defines the EntityContextDefinition class, which provides entity context definitions within Drupal. It includes methods for constructing context definitions from entity types, entity objects, and entity type IDs, as well as generating sample values based on entity storage and constraints.

classes.name: EntityContextDefinition
classes.description: Provides entity context definitions, allowing creation from entity types, entity objects, and entity type IDs, with sample value generation based on entity storage and constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EntityContextDefinition, prefixing data type with 'entity:' if not already prefixed.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the entity type ID by stripping the 'entity:' prefix from the data type.

methods.name: getConstraintObjects
methods.description: Retrieves or adds the 'EntityType' constraint object.

methods.name: getSampleValues
methods.description: Generates sample entity values based on storage and constraints, using entity type definitions and bundle options.

methods.name: fromEntityTypeId
methods.description: Creates a context definition from an entity type ID.

methods.name: fromEntityType
methods.description: Creates a context definition from an EntityTypeInterface object.

methods.name: fromEntity
methods.description: Creates a context definition from an EntityInterface object.
